subject: [PATCH v5 07/22] btrfs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the Btrfs direct I/O operations to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated by the DEFINE_IOMAP_ITER_NEXT_END() macro. This callback handles finishing previous mappings and producing the next one. The conversion does not introduce any functional changes.
